key_observations: The two-seed comparison is internally consistent enough to support a bounded methods note, although it does not establish a strong universal method ranking.
A stale notebook export produced a conflicting saved summary; tracing and regenerating the export removed the discrepancy without changing the main interpretation.
The method-by-noise interaction remains plausible but should be described cautiously, especially because the class-level reversal is not stable enough to support a strong claim.
The methods note now contains a compact results table, limitations, and narrow conclusion, while reproduction instructions were updated to preserve the current pipeline.
A brief search for additional benchmark datasets was deliberately parked because it was not required by the current scope.
priority_alignment: The researcher resolved a reproducibility issue before treating the pilot as complete.
The current evidence was converted into a bounded research artifact rather than expanding the experiment matrix.
The code and documentation were left in a cleaner reproducible state.
important_uncertainty: Two seeds on one dataset are insufficient to establish how general the observed interaction is.
The effect may depend on class composition and dataset characteristics.
It remains open whether a broader multi-dataset study would produce a consistent pattern.
expected_reflection.possible_next_step: Finish a final read-through of the bounded methods note and decide whether to circulate it for feedback; keep broader validation as a separate future study rather than an implicit next step.
